nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances tracking token balances
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances tracking approvals
uint256 private _totalSupply holding the total token supply
string private _name storing token name
string private _symbol storing token symbol
string private _version storing generator version
SimpleERC20 constructor: payable, mints initial balance to deployer and pays service fee
ERC20._mint internal: increases _totalSupply and _balances[account]
ERC20._transfer internal: moves balances between sender and recipient
ERC20._approve internal: writes _allowances[owner][spender]
ERC20._burn internal: decreases balance and _totalSupply
ERC20.transfer public: external transfer entry point using _msgSender()
ERC20.transferFrom public: spends allowance and transfers tokens
ERC20.approve public: sets allowance for spender by _msgSender()
ERC20.increaseAllowance public: adds to spender allowance with unchecked source value
ERC20.decreaseAllowance public: subtracts from spender allowance after require check
Context._msgSender returns msg.sender
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller identity used in mint and transfer paths
_mint(_msgSender(), initialBalance_) creating supply at deployment
_transfer(sender, recipient, amount) moving balances
_approve writes allowance computed from currentAllowance - amount
_burn reduces account balance and total supply
IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) external payable call in ServicePayer
constructor parameter name_ for token name
constructor parameter symbol_ for token symbol
constructor parameter initialBalance_ minted to deployer
constructor parameter feeReceiver_ payable address receiving service fee
local currentAllowance read from _allowances in transferFrom
local senderBalance read from _balances in _transfer
local accountBalance read from _balances in _burn
account address parameter of _mint/_burn
uint256 amount parameter across transfer/mint/burn/approve functions
address sender parameter of transferFrom/_transfer
address recipient parameter of transfer/transferFrom/_transfer
address spender parameter of approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance
address owner parameter of _approve/allowance
